# Why isn't your structured data eligible for rich results?

> Free JSON-LD and schema markup validator. Paste a page's HTML or JSON-LD and see every missing required and recommended property for Product, Article, LocalBusiness, Recipe, Event, JobPosting and more. Builds starter markup too. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/json-ld-rich-result-validator/)
